title: Jack Got Me Good — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal absurdist English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Joel rang Mum from the hospital bed
Said Jack drove the buggy right into my leg
Mum said — Joel, that is not how you drive
Joel said — Mum, I wasn't driving, I was just alive

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Mamma disse — Joel, stai bene davvero? [Mum said — Joel, are you really alright?]
Joel disse — solo la caviglia e la gamba, c'è un buco intero [Joel said — just the ankle and leg, there's a whole hole]
Lei disse — dov'era Jack quando è successo questo? [She said — where was Jack when this happened?]
Joel disse — al posto del guidatore, quello è stato il peggio [Joel said — in the driver's seat, that was the worst]

[Chorus — English]
Jack got me good, Jack got me good
I didn't see it coming like I thought I would
Broken leg, suspected, maybe the ankle too
Jack got me good — what are you gonna do

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Jack hat Joel gut erwischt, Jack hat Joel gut erwischt [Jack got Joel good, Jack got Joel good]
Ich habe das nicht kommen sehen, wie ich es hätte sollen [I didn't see it coming like I should have]
Gebrochenes Bein, vermutet, vielleicht auch der Knöchel [Broken leg, suspected, maybe the ankle too]
Jack hat Joel gut erwischt — was soll man da machen? [Jack got Joel good — what can you do?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas heard about it later that same night
Said — son, a golf buggy's not a bumper car, alright?

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
Jack got me good
Jack mi ha beccato bene [Jack got me good]
Jack hat mich gut erwischt [Jack got me good]
That's my boy
